label: A major eruption at Yosemite National Park
description: A day when a major eruption goes off at Yosemite National Park, given alongside Yellowstone and Mount Fuji with the timing unknown. Yosemite is a granite batholith with no volcanic system; the Long Valley caldera is a separate site about thirty miles east, so the named park is geologically wrong.
aliases: a major eruption go off in the Yose National Park
Yellowstone national park, Yoseite National Park

label: An olivewood wedding canopy with a fire that does not consume it
description: A hand-carved olivewood chuppah with four posts and a wooden floor, decorated with flowers, holding a fire that does not consume the wood and sustains itself in the air, located on the Oklahoma and Texas border, for the bridegroom getting ready for the bride. He compares his vision against an image shown on screen, which is how the detail gets fixed.
aliases: a fire that was not consuming the wood

label: Half the sky light and half dark in the middle of the day
description: Darkness in the middle of the day and light at the same time, half the sky light and half dark, which he says flipped him out and which he cannot explain except as an eclipse, an explanation he then rejects because an eclipse does not divide the sky in half.
aliases: half the sky was light and half the sky was dark
dark as night skies in the middle of the day
light one moment and dark one moment

label: Two and a half billion raised to buy Bitcoin at the top
description: Trump Media selling shares to fifty companies and raising two and a half billion dollars to buy Bitcoin at an all-time high, which he notes is the reverse of buying low and selling high. The raise was announced on 27 May 2025, four days before he discusses it, so this is news he is reasoning from rather than a prediction.
aliases: he raised up $2.5 billion to buy Bitcoin
usually people buy low and sell high

label: Revival starting in Japan among the youth
description: A great fire and revival starting in Japan among the youth and younger generations, against great corruption, sexual perversion and dark businessmen there. Japan is under one percent Christian and has been for a century, which makes it the hardest case he names.
aliases: I see it even starting in Japan
with the youth, with the younger generations
